caption: Sh. 1. Altar (Areika, Pl. 32, No. 5100)
reading: wosi asoreyi tlye(2)qo wi[.] kidteliye tedḫ[.](3)lowi tmeye (4)terikelowi[.] (5)snmdese teñ(6)tel yetmde(7)lowi[.] mlomrse (8)teñtelowi a(9)tomẖe psoẖe atmḫe : psi(11)ḫrto ḫmlol : (12)psitḫto ḫl(13)ẖl psiẖolto
notes: Altar copy set out in 7 rows, each in two or three groups; groups read right to left within each row, rows top to bottom, which follows Griffith's line numbers except that no (10) is printed anywhere in the copy. Hatched marks at the left end of rows 1, 3 and 4 (just before the final -wi) written [.]; they may be damaged dividers. 'S///' groups read as y + e (the slash taken as part of y). 'a?' at the start of row 2 (after wi[.]) is the long-tailed 2 preceded by a 4: could be i + a or a alone. The 3-shaped signs are uncertain throughout: '/3' read as s + o (could be q), e.g. in psoẖe, psisol, (2)qo; in row 6 the right group has a barred 3 read ẖ, the left group a c read ḫ. small flat-topped hooks read l, larger S read e; the size difference is not always clear. ñ in teñtel and teñtelowi is a plain cross (x) without loop; could be d. ϟ with a dot to its right in a(9)to read to. Final sign of rows 6-7 (a hook like a sideways b) read l?, uncertain.
check_notes: Names A tlyeqowi, B kidteliye, C tmeye; Index A/B snmdese teñtel yetmdelowi and mlomrse teñtelowi; formulae A (ato mẖe psoẖe), B (at mḫe : psiḫrto), C (ḫmlol : psitḫto), D1 (ḫlẖl psiẖolto). The 4+long-tailed sign at the start of the B name is i + k (k joined to i in the type). The final hooks of rows 6-7 are to; the thick hook in psitḫto is t. Index C prints pisiẖolto (with Kar. 12) and tmlye for n. C: the copy and the names table/formula table do not have them; kept. No line (10) in the copy.

caption: Sh. 2. Altar (Areika, Pl. 32, No. 5101)
labels: sic, by line 6 (over the a ... mẖe group before line 7)
reading: wosi[.] a(2)soreyi : (3)ḫwitn?[.][.][.][.]e?qowi : tm(4)rot?ikde : tedḫelowi[.] (5)qeremye te?[.][.][.]i? [.][.][.](6)l?o?wi : amẖe[.] (7)p[.]soẖ : a(8)tmẖe[.] p[.]ḫr[.] [.]mlo(9)l ẖol :
notes: Heavily hatched copy. Row order and groups as in the copy, each read right to left. The hatching after wosi and before -reyi each about one sign wide. In line 3 a long hatched stretch is counted as three signs. 'sic' stands over the a ... mẖe group at the right of row 4 (line 6): no t/to between a and m, unlike a(8)tmẖe. 'S///' read y + e. '/3' read s + o (could be q), e.g. in (2)so, rosik, (7)p[.]soẖ, soe. The long-tailed hatched sign before [.][.](6) and the long-tailed sign starting p?[.][.]ḫe? are unclear (p, k or a).
check_notes: Names A ḫwitn(?)[...]e(?)qowi, B tmrot(?)ikde, C qeremye; formulae A (a mẖe p[i]soẖ, sic), B (at mẖe p[s]ḫr :), C ([ḫ]mlol ẖol :). In this copy '/3' is q in qeremye but s+o in soreyi and p[.]soẖ, and ẖ+o in ẖol, so no general change was made. The hatched sign after n in the A name is taken as part of the lost stretch (Griffith's brackets). Index C psiẖebḫte (pl. form A, Sh. 2) could not be placed: the copy's formula A is p[.]soẖ. Lines 5-6 'te?[.][.][.]i?' are not covered by any entry.

caption: Sh. 3. Stela (Areika, Pl. 33, No. 5102)
labels: sic, by line 2 (over the dotted o of qowi)
sic, by line 7 (over te of ak(7)tels)
sic, by line 10 (over the first e of atomee)
reading: wosi soreyi : mklẖli (2)belolo ye qo : wi : ake(3)seye : tedḫeli : te(4)dḫelowi : qoreñlẖ : (5)bedewete : yese bo(6)ẖe : yetmdelowi : ap(7)telẖ : dodewiye : yetm(8)delowi : apotelẖ : ntepo(9)kl : yetmdelowi : mlomr(10)se : teñtelowi : atoẖme : (11)psoẖekete atmẖe : psiḫrk
notes: Row 3 of the copy has a short second line ':4B/ϟ  S' under its left end; read as the end of yetmd(•)... giving 'yetmd elowi'; a heavy dot between m and d in that row is not transcribed. In row 1 qowi has an extra dot by o (sic). The sign read k in ak?e, ak(7)tels, akote is a Σ standing on a long base stroke; k or p. a?kes?li: first sign a 2 with long tail (a? or n). 'S///' read y + e. '/3' read s + o (could be q) in psoẖ; '//3' read q + o in qowi and qoreñ?ls. ñ? in qoreñls is a plain λ; in teñtelowi it has a loop (ñ). i? in ni?ḫḫ?o is a plain cross (+) under a long base stroke beginning at the first c. In line 10 the S marked sic and the small hook after it are read e, e?; the formula elsewhere has ẖe there. The opening [.] of the last group is a ( with hatching.
check_notes: Index C mklẖli (line 1); names A beloloyeqo : wi, B akeseye; Index A/B/C qoreñlẖ : bedewete : yeseboẖe : yetmdelowi, aptelẖ : dodewiye, apotelẖ : ntepokl, mlo mrse teñtelowi, tedḫeli; formulae A (ato mẖ(?)e : psoẖekete; prose and Index C give ẖme, as the copy has it) and B (at mẖe : psiḫrk). The Σ on a base stroke is p in ap(7)telẖ and apotelẖ (type) but k in akeseye (type). The p of ntepokl is drawn as two c-like strokes on a base line. The λ is d in dodewiye, ñ in qoreñlẖ (type with loop). ap(7)telẖ lacks the o of apotelẖ (Griffith's sic). The dot by qo is taken as the divider qo : wi of the names table. Recheck of the last group found only one c (ḫ), not two.
